The game hasn't managed to load before, and that's why I have gone back several steps this week, and have changed some things. I have also made some very unappetizing changes that have caused problems, but only in terms of what I made. Now it seems that everything works well enough, and I'm still happy!

The next big thing is to put the game up on Steam, so that everyone can play it. Now that's it for the “technical part”. What's left is to prepare a good marketing for the game, and write some copy that suits our game as well as we can. I'm quite satisfied with what I've come up with so far, but the copywriting has definitely been one of the weak points so far.
